metadata.case_name: LI HUNG YING v. YIU KAI LUN

source: The above named patient sustained multiple injuries in a road traffic accident and she was admitted to the Intensive Care Unit on 5 April 2005. The injuries included bilateral femur fracture, first cervical vertebra fracture, right little finger fracture, left third rib fracture, right public ramus fracture, right orbital wall fracture and teeth loosening.
The bilateral femur fractures were fixed with internal fixation devices on 7 April 2005.

source: The above named patient sustained multiple injuries in a road traffic accident and she was admitted to the Intensive Care Unit on 5 April 2005. The injuries included bilateral femur fracture, first cervical vertebra fracture, right little finger fracture, left third rib fracture, right public ramus fracture, right orbital wall fracture and teeth loosening.
CT scan shown fracture of cervical vertebrate C1 and right medical orbital wall fracture.

“… She was knocked down by a taxi resulting on fracture medical wall of right orbit. Upon subsequent assessments, her vision returned normal. The fracture did not cause symptoms and did not require surgical intervention. The fracture should not cause problems to her daily activities.”

injuries.description: Dental injury: Grade I mobility / subluxation of dentition (teeth 11, 12, 21) and dentoalveolar injury; extractions and replacement by fixed bridge
source: Grade I mobility of dentition 11 12 21 was found. The differential diagnosis of subluxation 11 12 21 and dentoalveolus fracture involving the above dentition were made. Definitive diagnosis can be confirmed only by dental x-ray only when patient was transferred out from ICU. She was revealed on 30th April, 05 in our out-patient clinic with occlusal x-ray showing consistent clinical picture of subluxed dentition 11 12 21 with pre- existing periodontal condition ……
4 teeth had to be extracted and replaced by fixed bridge.

injuries.description: Laceration on upper lip with broken upper incisor teeth
source: On arrival, she was dull, could obey simple verbal command. There were multiple bruises abrasions and swelling (haematoma) on her right cheek, back & left hip. Her upper incisor teeth were broken with laceration on upper lip. Her bilateral thighs regions were swollen and deformed.

manifestations.description: Managed to walk unaided at home and used one crutch while going out-door
Has to take a rest after walking about 15 to 30 minutes
Right knee is grossly swollen and stiff
Right lower limb is shorter by 2 cm than that of the left
Cannot do and enjoy jogging and swimming as before the accident

treatments_received: Internal fixation surgery for bilateral femur fractures (7 April 2005)
Adjustment of right femur fixation (6 June 2005)
Splintage of right little finger fracture
Analgesics for right pubic ramus fracture
Surgical / Ophthalmological management for orbital wall fracture
Dental assessment and outpatient dental treatment

losses.description: Limping gait; needs rest after walking 15-30 minutes; uses one crutch when going outdoors.
Effect of scars and swelling on her lower limbs.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Cannot do and enjoy jogging and swimming as she was before the accident.
Unable to return to her pre-accident job as an office maid/cleaner and difficulty in finding suitable work.
